title: HERD: Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation for Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.31401v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continual learning requires a model to keep acquiring new skills and knowledge without compromising its existing capabilities. Parametric methods suffer from catastrophic forgetting and loss of plasticity. Non-parametric methods, such as prompts, skills, and harnesses, leverage in-context learning but are limited by context length and lossy plain-text compression. To effectively combine their complementary strengths, we propose HERD (Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation), a hybrid continual learning framework that learns efficiently in the harness and internalizes experience into cumulative capabilities via distillation. On the harness side, HERD continually refines its skills to capture reusable patterns, while retaining high-residual examples that the skills fail to capture in a bounded memory. On the parameter side, HERD performs drift-constrained distillation with dual anchors, substantially reducing forgetting over long recursive

translated_title: HERD：面向持续学习的工具链演化递归蒸馏
translated_abstract: 持续学习要求模型在不损害既有能力的前提下不断获取新技能与新知识。参数化方法面临灾难性遗忘和可塑性丧失的困扰；非参数化方法（如提示、技能和工具链）虽借助上下文学习，却受限于上下文长度和有损的纯文本压缩。为有效结合二者的互补优势，我们提出HERD（工具链演化递归蒸馏）——一个混合式持续学习框架，它在工具链中高效学习，并通过蒸馏将经验内化为累积能力。在工具链方面，HERD持续精炼其技能以捕捉可复用的模式，同时在有限记忆中保留技能无法覆盖的高残差样本；在参数方面，HERD采用带双锚点的漂移约束蒸馏，在长递归过程中显著减少遗忘。
tldr: 提出HERD混合持续学习框架，通过可演化的工具链高效学习，并以双锚点漂移约束蒸馏将经验内化为参数化累积能力，从而在持续获取新知识的同时大幅减少遗忘。
en_tdlr: HERD is a hybrid continual learning framework that combines an evolving harness for efficient in-context learning with dual-anchor drift-constrained distillation to internalize experience into parameters, enabling continual skill acquisition while substantially reducing catastrophic forgetting.
